title: Murder
text: Whoever causes death with intention — punishment death or imprisonment for life. (Old IPC 302)

title: Cruelty by husband/relatives
text: Cruelty as defined — punishment up to 3 years. (Old IPC 498A)

title: Anticipatory bail
text: Directions for grant of bail when person apprehends arrest. (Old CrPC 438)

title: Expert opinion
text: Opinions of experts upon point of foreign law, science, art relevant. (Old Evidence 45)

title: Admissibility of electronic records
text: Electronic records admissible with certificate. (Old Evidence 65B)
